topic: Passive with Verbs with Two Objects
task_instruction: Rewrite each active sentence in the passive voice. Use either object as the subject.
paragraphs: At an oncology clinic, a care team helps patients understand their chemotherapy appointments and support options. A nurse welcomes a patient named Elena and reviews the information she requested. {{red:The nurse gives Elena a schedule for her treatment visits.}} {{mask_1}} The oncology pharmacist explains the medicine plan. {{red:The pharmacist has sent Elena a written summary of the medicines.}} {{mask_2}} A social worker describes practical services. {{red:The social worker offers Elena a list of transportation resources.}} {{mask_3}} Before the appointment, the clinic coordinator speaks with Elena's family. {{red:The coordinator gave them the clinic's telephone number.}} {{mask_4}}

The team discusses how side effects are monitored and whom Elena can contact. {{red:The oncology nurse taught Elena the names of the members of her care team yesterday.}} {{mask_5}} The pharmacist checks that instructions are easy to follow. {{red:The pharmacist is showing Elena the medicine information sheet now.}} {{mask_6}} Elena asks about keeping track of questions between visits. {{red:The nurse will give her a symptom diary at the next appointment.}} {{mask_7}} The social worker answers a question about financial support. {{red:The hospital has offered Elena a consultation with a financial counselor.}} {{mask_8}}

At the next visit, the care team reviews Elena's notes and concerns. {{red:The physician showed Elena the expected schedule last week.}} {{mask_9}} A nurse helps her prepare for the following days. {{red:The nurse is bringing Elena a printed list of questions for her care team.}} {{mask_10}} The pharmacist reviews how to contact the clinic. {{red:The pharmacist will send Elena the after-hours telephone instructions.}} {{mask_11}} The counselor checks that Elena knows about available services. {{red:The counselor has promised Elena a call after the appointment.}} {{mask_12}}

The clinic also supports Elena's family, with her permission. {{red:The nurse gave Elena's sister a guide to supporting someone during treatment.}} {{mask_13}} The dietitian discusses food and hydration in general terms. {{red:The dietitian is offering Elena several meal-planning suggestions.}} {{mask_14}} Elena asks for a copy of the care plan. {{red:The coordinator had emailed Elena the appointment details before the visit.}} {{mask_15}} The social worker discusses community resources. {{red:The social worker will provide Elena's family with information about a local support group.}} {{mask_16}}

Before Elena leaves, the team makes sure she has clear contact information and understands her next steps. {{red:The physician has given Elena a copy of the updated care plan.}} {{mask_17}} The nurse checks whether she needs help arranging a ride home. {{red:The clinic offered Elena a ride home after her previous appointment.}} {{mask_18}} Elena asks how she will receive changes to her schedule. {{red:The coordinator will text her the new appointment time if it changes.}} {{mask_19}} The pharmacist closes the consultation by reviewing written instructions. {{red:The pharmacist read Elena the key points from the medicine guide.}} {{mask_20}} Elena leaves knowing that she can contact her care team with questions.
